equipment_type: Steam or hot water boiler control via BACnet gateway
applies_to: Cleaver-Brooks boilers with the HAWK 4000 V2 PLC boiler control, read through a ProtoNode RER gateway.
summary: The ProtoNode maps the HAWK 4000 V2 boiler control to BACnet: a long list of alarm and status bits (limits, actuators, sensors, flame safeguard), steam pressure or water temperature, setpoints, firing rate, stack and economizer temperatures, burner control status lines, run time and cycles. The BMS can start the boiler, write a remote setpoint or firing rate, and must keep a heartbeat bit updated.
notes: Each Cleaver-Brooks controller on the ProtoNode is its own BACnet device; the object instances below are the same on every device.

The guide prints no write-point stars for this profile; the AV/BV objects map to Metasys N2 outputs and Modbus output registers or coils, so they are taken as writable. Access is inferred from object type.
The guide gives no engineering units or state texts; units appear only where the object name carries them (DEG F / DEG C).
Where a description is filled in, it gives the register from the guide's Modbus column.

source.title: Cloud Enabled ProtoNode Gateway Startup Guide (RER/LER) for interfacing Cleaver-Brooks products

integration.summary: Start the boiler with BV 2 and keep BV 1 heartbeat toggling; write the operating setpoint (AV 1) or a remote firing rate (AV 2). Read load demand, steam pressure or water temperature, firing rate and the alarm output.

minimum_points.why: Steam pressure or hot water temperature
minimum_points.name: Steam Pressure or Hot Water Temp

integration.enable: BV 2 Remote Start From BMS; BI 47 shows the boiler's remote enable input. The firing-rate mode bits (BI 58-60) show whether remote, manual or auto modulation is active.
integration.heartbeat: BV 1 Heart Beat From BMS is written by the BMS; the guide does not state the timeout.
setup: BACnet Device Instance = the controller's Modbus Node-ID + Node_Offset (default 50,000), so Node-ID 1 = 50001. Change Node_Offset in the ProtoNode web configurator to pick other instances.
The ProtoNode RER does BACnet MS/TP or BACnet IP, selected on its S bank DIP switches.
BACnet MS/TP: one MAC address (1-127) for the whole ProtoNode on the A bank DIP switches; baud on B0-B3 (38400 factory default).
BACnet IP: default ProtoNode address 192.168.1.24; change it in the web configurator.
gotchas: Elapsed time and cycle counts appear twice: as two 16-bit word objects and as single objects.
Objects named AWB[..] or AWR[..] are spare tags in the profile with no stated use.
